verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents a few of its own multi-item features: some parameters accept several values in one request (comma-separated advertiser IDs in Ads Transparency, multiple departure airports in Flights). It also offers an async submit-then-retrieve mode via the Searches Archive API that eases high-volume fan-out. However, there is no general batch or bulk endpoint, and large-scale runs (e.g. millions of queries) are described only as user-built scripts. missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk search endpoint usable across all engines, bulk result retrieval or export, documented bulk throughput or rate limits, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
